answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to work in research and development within the entertainment industry, helping create new technologies, tools, and experiences that improve how content is produced and how audiences engage with it. I’m especially interested in combining science, technology, and creativity to contribute to innovative projects behind the scenes.
answers.drew: I’m drawn to the entertainment industry because it brings together creativity, technology, and an understanding of how people connect with stories and experiences. I’m especially interested in research and development, where emerging technologies and new ideas can improve how content is created, delivered, and experienced. I would love to contribute my background in science, research, and technology to help develop innovative and meaningful experiences for audiences.
answers.seeking: I’m looking to connect with people working in research and development, emerging technology, production innovation, and other behind-the-scenes areas of entertainment. I’d also love to meet professionals and fellow interns who are interested in combining creativity with science and technology to shape the future of the industry.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Ken Jeong. I admire how he successfully transitioned from a science-based professional background into entertainment and used his unique experiences to build a distinctive creative career. His journey shows that analytical thinking and creativity can complement each other, which inspires me to bring my own research and technology interests into the entertainment industry.
answers.favorite: How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies
